tasks.DescribeMassUnit: To provide the metric unit used to describe the mass of an object.

Questions.content: What is the standard metric unit for measuring mass, and how does it differ from other units of measurement?
What is the specific metric unit used to express mass, and in which context might other units be preferred?
What is the specific metric unit used to express the mass of an object, and in what context might kilograms not be the preferred unit?

tasks.MassMeasurementQuery: Determine the metric unit used to describe the mass of an object.

Questions.content: What is the base unit of mass in the International System of Units (SI)?
What is an example of an object and its mass in the metric system to better illustrate the unit used?
What is the conversion factor between kilograms and grams to further illustrate the metric unit of mass?

tasks.IdentifyMetricUnit: Determine the metric unit used for describing the mass of an object.

Questions.content: What is the base unit of mass in the International System of Units (SI)?
What is the symbol used to denote the metric unit of mass in the International System of Units (SI)?
What is the name of the metric unit used to describe the mass of an object in everyday language?
